description: This Java source file defines the SavingsProductToGLAccountMappingHelper class, which extends ProductToGLAccountMappingHelper. It provides methods to handle saving, merging, updating, and deleting GL account mappings related to savings products within the Fineract accounting module. The class also manages account mappings for different accounting rules, payment channels, and charges specific to savings products.

classes.name: SavingsProductToGLAccountMappingHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing GL account mappings for savings products, including saving, merging, updating, and deleting account configurations, as well as handling different accounting rules and payment channel associations.

methods.name: saveSavingsToAssetAccountMapping
methods.description: Persists a mapping between a savings product and an asset GL account based on provided JSON data.

methods.name: saveSavingsToIncomeAccountMapping
methods.description: Persists a mapping between a savings product and an income GL account.

methods.name: saveSavingsToExpenseAccountMapping
methods.description: Persists a mapping between a savings product and an expense GL account.

methods.name: saveSavingsToLiabilityAccountMapping
methods.description: Persists a mapping between a savings product and a liability GL account.

methods.name: mergeSavingsToAssetAccountMappingChanges
methods.description: Merges changes to the GL account mappings for a savings product's asset accounts.

methods.name: mergeSavingsToIncomeAccountMappingChanges
methods.description: Merges changes to the GL account mappings for a savings product's income accounts.

methods.name: mergeSavingsToExpenseAccountMappingChanges
methods.description: Merges changes to the GL account mappings for a savings product's expense accounts.

methods.name: mergeSavingsToLiabilityAccountMappingChanges
methods.description: Merges changes to the GL account mappings for a savings product's liability accounts.

methods.name: createOrmergeSavingsToLiabilityAccountMappingChanges
methods.description: Creates or merges changes to liability account mappings for savings products.

methods.name: savePaymentChannelToFundSourceMappings
methods.description: Associates payment channels with fund sources for savings products.

methods.name: updatePaymentChannelToFundSourceMappings
methods.description: Updates payment channel to fund source mappings for savings products.

methods.name: saveChargesToIncomeAccountMappings
methods.description: Saves income account mappings related to charges for savings products.

methods.name: updateChargeToIncomeAccountMappings
methods.description: Updates income account mappings associated with charges.

methods.name: populateChangesForNewSavingsProductToGLAccountMappingCreation
methods.description: Prepares a map of changes to create new GL account mappings for a savings product based on accounting rules.

methods.name: handleChangesToSavingsProductToGLAccountMappings
methods.description: Handles and applies changes to a savings product's GL account mappings according to the specified accounting rule.

methods.name: deleteSavingsProductToGLAccountMapping
methods.description: Deletes all GL account mappings associated with a specified savings product.
